summary:
SELNE SPACE LIFE

Space Life and Mission Simulation

SELNE Space Life is an independent educational game project designed to help players explore the challenges of living and working in space through an interactive gaming experience.

The project introduces essential aspects of human life in space, including oxygen, water, nutrition, pressure, temperature, safety, and communication.

Through mission-based activities, players are encouraged to follow instructions, check equipment, complete objectives, and understand the importance of safety and planning in the space environment.

The project aims to promote scientific curiosity, problem-solving skills, and awareness of human space exploration, particularly among younger generations.

Its main goal is to demonstrate that living in space involves much more than exploration; it requires scientific knowledge, technology, preparation, and responsibility.

The project also seeks expert feedback to improve its scientific accuracy and educational value.
